usage: 半 (bun3) means 'half' and is used to describe a portion or amount.
You can use 半 to talk about half a fruit or half a quantity of vegetables.
半 is often used when you only want part of something instead of the whole.
It can describe half the size, half the amount, or half the price in shopping.
半 can also be used in cooking instructions, like 'half an onion' or 'half a cup'.
